body:
ten years ago today, the lights went out.

july 17, 2016: an edited call hits snapchat, snake emojis flood every comment section, and a worldwide hashtag declares her over.

her only answer: "I would very much like to be excluded from this narrative."

then — 11 months of silence. and then the snake struck back. 🐍

we built the full timeline of that day and everything it became → longlivets.com
